summary: Google DeepMind released dm-haiku v0.0.17, a minor version of its JAX neural network library exposing a new vmap parameter and improving VJP performance, alongside JAX compatibility fixes.

practices.reason: A new parameter exposed in hk.vmap changes the library's API surface for teams building on Haiku.
The stated VJP performance improvement via slicing could speed up backward-pass computation for teams using static_unroll, though the gain is not quantified.
practices.quote: Improve `static_unroll` VJP performance by slicing via `jnp.unstack`.
